title.zh: ⚡️OpenAI指控前员工入职苹果前泄密，知识产权纠纷再度升级
title.en: ⚡️OpenAI指控前员工入职苹果前泄密，知识产权纠纷再度升级

current_state.zh: OpenAI accused a former employee of sending over 100 confidential files about its unreleased hardware to a personal account and showing the products to Apple executives before joining Apple, escalating the trade-secret dispute after Apple's prior suit against OpenAI.
